Three ways to decide with confidence

Check the specs

Compare the listed dimensions with your space: beam length, corbel depth, shutter height, mantel width. Painter's tape on the wall or ceiling shows you the scale.

See the material in person

Polyurethane and Timberthane faux wood samples, plus vinyl shutter color kits, let you judge color and texture in your own light.

Shop now →

Talk it through

Call 1-888-573-3768 with your measurements and we'll help you choose the size and material. Mon-Fri 8am-6pm CT, Sat 8am-12pm CT.

 

If it's made to order

Made-to-order pieces, like vinyl and wood shutters, are built to your size and finish after you order, so they can't be returned. Double-check your measurements before you buy; we're glad to check them with you.
